editorial:
Imagine you are driving home after a long day at work and get stuck behind a slow funeral parade. That is exactly how things start for Melvin, a rich guy who thinks he has everything under control. But suddenly, things get weird. He starts seeing a spooky hearse and a strange woman in a sports car everywhere he goes. The whole movie feels like a bad dream where you are running away from something but cannot quite figure out what it is. It creates a creepy mood that makes you wonder if Melvin is losing his mind or if something supernatural is actually hunting him down.

What really works here is how the tension builds up slowly. The acting is solid, and the twist will definitely catch you off guard. It is not a fast movie, but the mystery keeps you interested. If you like old-school horror that messes with your head, you will love this. You should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the colors pop, or you can just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend when you want something a bit strange.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that Melvin is actually dead. The car crash at the start of the movie killed him, and the funeral procession he saw was actually for him. The strange visions and the woman chasing him were signs that he was stuck between life and death. By the end, he realizes the truth and finally accepts his fate, allowing his soul to leave the world of the living behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological twists and old Italian horror movies.
